searchText: Call recording: https://youtu.be/0vHHhZgrJ58 On another note, I've just published a set of potential ACD, network upgrade, and EthMagicians process improvements based on many conversations over the past year, and the recent session in Kenya: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/allcoredevs-network-upgrade-ethmagicians-process-improvements/20157 If teams could review by next ACD*E* (two weeks from now), it'd be great to discuss implementing some of these changes then 😄 Specifically, the three that feel most important to discuss on the call are: - ACD Proposal 1: EIP Review Requests - NUP Proposal 1: PFI, CFI, SFI - NUP Proposal 3.1: Client Team EIP Editors by Default The rest can probably be handled async/elsewhere.
